verdict.rationale: Fern exposes an API (an openapi.json probe returned HTTP 200), so this axis applies. However, the pack has no evidence that Fern's own APIs are versioned or that Fern publishes a deprecation policy. The 'Versions' feature is a docs-site dropdown that customers use to show multiple releases of their own content. That is an adjacent feature, not Fern's API versioning or deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
